Name: Location Tuner
Author: klatuprism
Description:
This mod was created to provide a GUI to customize the environmental settings for Farm Expansions in one of my other mods, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10512]Stardew Realty[/url].  After testing I discovered that the GUI can also adjust the settings for any Outdoors Game Location.  Each Location can be set to its' own independent values. 

There are a whole bunch of Parameters that can be adjusted:

[color=#00ff00][size=4][b][u]Basic Settings[/u][/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*] [color=#ffff00][b]All Locations[/b][/color]
[list]
[*] [b][color=#00ffff]Weather[/color][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Seasonal Override[/b] - set a location to a permanent season
[*][b]Disable Debris Weather[/b] - stops pollen and leaves from blowing throughout the location
[*][b]Disable Cloud spawning[/b] - stop cloud shadows from floating across the location
[/list][*] [b][color=#00ffff]Crops and Grass[/color][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Enable/Disable crop planting[/b]
[*][b]Enable/Disable seeds ignoring seasonal requirements[/b] - allow the planting of a seed regardless of the seeds planting season
[*][b]Enable/Disable tree planting[/b]
[*][b]Enable/Disable Giant Crop spawning[/b] - enables the potential spawning of giant crops
[*][b]Enable/Disable Grass Surviving in winter[/b] - uncut grass will not be destroyed when winter arrives
[*][b]Enable/Disable Grass Growing in winter[/b]
[*][b]Enable/Disable Grass spreading[/b]
[*][b]Enable/Disable Green Rain Spawns[/b]
[*][b]Disable weed growth[/b]
[/list][*] [b][color=#00ffff]Critters[/color][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Disable Bird spawning[/b]
[*][b]Disable Butterfly spawning[/b]
[*][b]Disable Rabbit spawning[/b]
[*][b]Disable Woodpecker spawning[/b]
[*][b]Disable Squirrel spawning[/b]
[*][b]Disable Owl spawning[/b]
[*][b]Disable Opossum spawning[/b]
[*][b]Disable Frog spawning[/b]
[/list][*] [b][color=#00ffff]Foraging[/color][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Set minimum daily forage spawn[/b]
[*][b]Set maximum daily forage spawn[/b]
[*][b]Set maximum total forage items[/b]
[*][b]Set minimum daily weed spawn[/b]
[*][b]Set maximum daily weed spawn[/b]
[*][b]Set the monthly weed multiplier[/b]
[*][b]Set the daily dirt decay chance[/b]
[*][b]Set the chance for clay[/b]
[/list][*] [b][color=#00ffff]Miscellaneous[/color][/b]
[list][*][b]Enable/Disable building[/b]
[/list][/list][*][b][color=#ffff00]Farm and Stardew Realty Expansions Only[/color][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Disable Lightning[/b]
[*][b]Disable Crow spawning[/b]
[/list][/list][color=#00ff00][size=4][b][u]Advanced Setting[/u][/b][/size][/color][list]
[*][b]Location Context[/b]
[/list]
[color=#00ff00][size=4][u][b]Install[/b][/u][/size][/color][list]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list][color=#00ff00][size=4][u][b]How To Use[/b][/u][/size][/color][list=1][*]Go to the location you want to tune.
[*]Press the mod activation key. ([Control][F2] is the default and can be changed via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]﻿)
[*]Change the parameters you want and press 'Save'.
[*]The changes will take effect immediately.
[/list][b][u][color=#ff0000][size=4]Caution[/size][/color][/u][/b]
With great power comes great responsibility.  Care must be taken when changing parameters.  If you enable crop planting in a location and later on you disable crop planting, your crops will die.  Changing the Seasonal override will impact any crops currently growing.  The other parameters do no have such drastic effects and their tuning will not cause great catastrophes.

[color=#00ff00][size=4][b][u]Configuration[/u][/b][/size][/color]
There are 2 configurable options (via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url])
[list]
[*]Activation Key - this is the key press that will bring up the tuning menu
[*]Show Advanced Settings - this shows or  hides the Location Context setting
[/list]
[b][u][color=#00ff00][size=4]Advanced Settings Usage[/size][/color][/u][/b]
The Location Context setting is used by the game and mods for various purposes, so changing its setting in specialized areas (like SVE or RSV) may have undesired results.  I have not done in depth testing with the impacts, so be careful.  If you are using my mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10512]Stardew Realty[/url] there are an assortment of Contexts that can be  used to make a location always sunny, always raining, always snowing, etc.  Using these contexts on SDR Farm Expansions do not have any adverse effects.

[b][u][color=#00ff00][size=4]Seasonal Override[/size][/color][/u][/b]
The seasonal Override setting is used by most of the game to make seasonal decisions.  However, the weather does not check for seasonal overrides.  This means that you can have a location set for permanent summer, but it will snow there during the winter season of the game.  [url=https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/30114/30114-1734353927-1476809819.jpeg]Summer snow example[/url]. As you can see from the example image, the weather is snowing but the cows are out grazing and the crops are still growing.
